prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image: the sole reference is the EDIT TARGET, the existing Breachline painting "Ambrel at the Lamplighting Hour".
Primary request: correct the physically impossible pedestrian bridge in the LEFT MIDDLE DISTANCE. Currently the right end of the little arched bridge terminates at a detached pillar in open canal water. Reconstruct ONLY this bridge and the minimum adjacent bank needed so it crosses from the left-bank walkway to the opposite STONE QUAY BESIDE THE CENTRAL COLONNADED READING COURT. Both bridge ends must visibly meet continuous solid paved ground. Show the far landing connected to the court's quay through a short believable stone stair or paved approach. A person must be able to walk from one bank across the bridge and onto the other bank without jumping over water. Use consistent perspective, realistic arch supports and handrails. No platform that ends in water, disconnected pier, doorway over open water or rails blocking the route. If necessary shift and lengthen the bridge slightly to reach the actual far bank; clear spatial function matters more than retaining the faulty span.
Keep the large cropped FOREGROUND stone balustrade, skyline, houses, observatory roofs, central reading court, blue-hour sky, amber lamps, lamplighter, water reflections, overall composition and traditional visible oil-and-acrylic brushwork unchanged. The small bridge pedestrians may be repositioned on its continuous walkway to fit the repair; everyone remains small, simple and human. Do not add lionfolk, orcs, new characters, infrastructure machinery, canals or water features. Do not beautify faces or smooth the paint into waxy glossy surfaces.
No text, labels, frame or watermark. Same landscape 1536x1024. This is a non-canon working revision, not a new setting proposal.
visual_review: Viewed: bridge now connects both banks, with a far landing and stairs into the court quay. Lighting and overall city composition preserved. Not approved as canon.
